entry.title: One in a Thousand — Chapter 7, The Refusal
entry.summary: Canon's fusion week runs whole; and the trade learns its first "no" — the pig refuses a clean boat, the buy is lost, the reason is found in the boat's own wood, and the tin stands at five coins eighty.

entry.title: One in a Thousand — Chapters 1–6 on the shelf
entry.summary: A new serial joins the shelf: Su Yan of Glorybound — the physician's boy with the trash beast-soul and the plate's one — walks his own road beside canon's in Soul Land 3. Six chapters live, every one gate-checked.

entry.title: One in a Thousand — Chapter 6, Thirty Thousand
entry.summary: The spring tests print ten; the Spirit Pagoda's wall written into the clinic's book; the tin counted out loud — and the first coins of the trade come home.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — Chapter 12, The Bull at the Water
entry.summary: The bull taken at the water; the deep light; the crossing — thirty paces of open fern, the hound pointing, the quiet held.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — Chapter 11, The War of the Lists
entry.summary: The thaw chapter in the canon voice: the second line taken, the enemy read, the thick-paw taken — and the hunters write the beast onto their list.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — the donghua lens (Ch 10)
entry.summary: The animated series checked and its structure made law: complete mini-arc openings, merged beats, flashback panels, the ceremonial beat. The Cold Country under all three lenses.

entry.title: The dragon, on one page — the OC status sheet
entry.summary: Everything about the Devouring Dragon on one page — auto-generated on every ship, freshness enforced by the Sentinel.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — Chapter 9, The Keeping Earned
entry.summary: The craft, the decoy, the voice's lessons, the ledge hunt, the greatness, the red thing — rewritten in the canon voice under the manhua lens. Facts unchanged.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — the manhua lens deepened (Ch 8)

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — the manhua lens (Ch 7)

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — canon-voice batch 2 (Ch 4–6)

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — the canon-voice edition begins (Ch 1–3)
entry.summary: Author ruling: write it like the source. Canon fetched and studied; Chapters 1–3 rewritten in the canon voice (facts unchanged), the rollout continues chapter by chapter.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — Chapter 24, The Stone Country
entry.summary: The opposite country: distance the ruler, the high kinds' teaching, the warmth map, and the thin bargain. The scree wrong — the mountain's memory of noise — and the first pass crossed in the gray kind's company. 2,198 words, PANEL: NONE, sweep PASS 24/24.
